930 deaths in children aged <5 years were identified
representing 73.3% of the 1,269 deaths that were expected
Among an expected 277 stillbirths, 172 (62%) were reported.
The percentage of expected deaths that were reported declined from 92% in 2015 to 53% in 2016.
to evaluate reporting completeness by comparing the number of documented deaths with national mortality estimates
Data from three existing reporting streams were used in this analysis

methods_quotes.q: using national mortality rates for all children aged <5 years (approximately 120 of 1,000 live births)
Expected stillbirths were calculated using the following formula: stillbirths = live births x stillbirth rate (SBR)/(1 – SBR).
Deaths in children aged <5 years were calculated using the formula: deaths = live births x mortality rate
Deaths were linked across data sources using the child’s name
expected stillbirths and deaths were calculated based on point estimates
